Sing along to vintage Christmas favorites
Pair it with the morning Christmas parade
site: Johnny Wild and The Delights Christmas Spectacular
about: The City of Apopka calendar lists the Apopka Holiday Concert with Johnny Wild and The Delights Christmas Spectacular on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 5 PM to 7 PM at Kit Land Nelson Park. The city and its Facebook post both mark it free.

The city says the band celebrates the merriest time of the year with an action packed romp through vintage Christmas and holiday favorites, and its Facebook post adds that you can enjoy them surrounded by the park's beautiful setting.

December is busy at the park. The City of Apopka's December schedule lists the annual Apopka Tree Lighting and Holiday Market presented by AdventHealth on Friday, December 4, from 6 PM to 8 PM, and the 50th Annual Christmas Parade on December 12 from 10 AM to noon, themed A Star Spangled Christmas for the nation's 250th year.
The city calendar prints no age guide, parking note or rain plan, so check the city's social pages on the day if the weather looks uncertain.
faq: When is the Apopka Holiday Concert 2026?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 5 PM to 7 PM.
Where is it?
Kit Land Nelson Park in Apopka.
Is it free?
Yes, the city calls it a free concert.
Who performs?
Johnny Wild and The Delights, with a Christmas Spectacular show.
What music will we hear?
Vintage Christmas and holiday favorites, per the city.
Is the parade the same day?
Yes, the 50th Annual Christmas Parade runs 10 AM to noon on December 12.
When is the tree lighting?
Friday, December 4, from 6 PM to 8 PM at Kit Land Nelson Park, per the city.

kids: Watch a Christmas light show set to festive music
Choose an early 6 PM show on Thursdays, Fridays and Sundays
Grab a drink at Redwell, which will be open serving coffee
about: Treasure Coast Community Church, called TC3, presents Radiance, a Christmas light show in its courtyard at 20 NE Dixie Highway in Stuart. The church's Church Center page lists the run as November 28 through December 31, 2026.

Showtimes differ by day. Thursdays, Fridays and Sundays have shows at 6, 7, 8 and 9 PM, while Saturdays have shows at 7:30, 8:30 and 9:30 PM. The church invites families and friends to make it a holiday outing, and says Redwell will be open serving coffee.

The church describes dazzling lights, festive music and Christmas cheer, and a local Facebook post calls the show free to check out. The church registration page itself does not print a price or an age guide.
Because shows repeat through the evening, a family with young children can pick the 6 PM show on a Thursday, Friday or Sunday and still get home at a reasonable hour.
faq: When does Radiance run in Stuart?
November 28 through December 31, 2026.
What are the showtimes?
Thursdays, Fridays and Sundays at 6, 7, 8 and 9 PM; Saturdays at 7:30, 8:30 and 9:30 PM.
Where is it?
The courtyard at TC3, 20 NE Dixie Highway, Stuart.
Is there a price?
The church page does not print one, and local posts call it free to check out.
Is there coffee?
Yes, the church says Redwell will be open serving coffee.
Do I need a ticket?
The church page does not mention tickets.
Is it indoors or outdoors?
It is held in the courtyard.
